active.summary: AppForge Terminal exits when opened on the real Android device
active.evidence_required: Install the fresh post-merge APK, open AppForge Terminal on the real Android device, confirm it remains open and usable, then verify logcat has no TerminalView mRenderer FATAL EXCEPTION.
active.root_cause: Termux TerminalView mRenderer was null when Compose AndroidView layout called onSizeChanged()->updateSize().
